subject: english
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.

The family can __none long stay__ in their big house.
solution:
The correct answer is __**No longer stay**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• There should be** no longer stay** instead of **none long stay**.
 
• The **above sentence means** that the family cant stay in their big house anymore.
 
• None is **pronoun form** of no. It is used to replace countable and uncountable nouns as a pronoun.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Determiners **are a word that modifies the type of reference a noun or noun group has, such as a, the, or every.
 
• **Determiners include **articles (a, an, the), cardinal and ordinal numbers (one, two, three...), demonstratives (this, that, these, those), partitives (some of, piece of, and others), quantifiers (most, all, and others), and difference words (other, another).
 
• Example : I like **this **new book.
